text: Adds sc_relationship_map(), seeded relationship-affinity optimizer scores worst-case CIE2000 separation across normal simulated CVD views, preserves hard canonical locks, limits canonical changes explicit stability budget, records effective matrix, baseline, settings, outcome, construction provenance versioned map. Adds sc_relationship_from_knn() exact within-sample coordinate neighborhoods, pairwise-complete aggregation equal sample weights, recorded construction support metadata. Adds sc_redundant_encoding() assign shapes, patterns, combinations CVD-confusable color pairs without changing colors. Removes unresolved ArchR palette snapshot installed archr_* registry entries; ArchR longer package palette-data dependency. Pins every remaining third-party palette exact licensed source package, version, URL, SHA-256 checksum, resolves Glasbey Polychrome provenance-review entries Polychrome 1.6.1. Adds deterministic build-time generation package-owned palettes frozen registry diagnostics deutan, protan, tritan simulations. Bundles exact 256-color viridisLite 0.4.3 scico 1.5.0 lookup tables, preserving provider output without runtime palette-package dependencies. Adds versioned Draft 2020-12 color-map schema lossless JSON/CSV interchange mappings, hierarchy, focus, provenance, aliases, locks, history, context, seeds, JSON-native extension metadata. Legacy files migrated, unknown future schema versions rejected. Makes hierarchy growth append-: new parents children receive colors without changing established child assignments parent anchors, including serialization restoration. Reports biological labels colors worst palette pairs, retains exact duplicate collisions, avoids categorical-cardinality warnings continuous palettes, makes qualitative recommendation cutoffs explicitly opt-. Adds cross-platform R CMD check (including declared R 4.2 minimum), pinned-source verification palette-database regeneration, informational coverage, check-gated pkgdown deployment workflows. Removes unused framework testing packages Suggests. Initial release persistent color maps, hierarchy-aware mappings, qualitative continuous scales, deterministic palette extension, accessibility diagnostics, provenance metadata. Adds sc_example, deterministic synthetic PBMC-like dataset demonstrating identity, lineage, sample, condition, expression, signed-score, pseudotime, QC color semantics. Removes ArchR-specific pal_archr() helper unprefixed palette aliases. Adds chromatic_balance, package-owned diverging HCL palette signed scores centered zero. Adds d3_rainbow d3_cool explicit CELLXGENE compatibility palettes. cyclic rainbow reproduces count- order-dependent categorical colors excluded persistent sc_color_map() assignments; cool scale includes CELLXGENE’s exact 100 source bins offers smooth continuous-scale compatibility low--high direction.
